description: Third-party service tiles shown in the MetaBuilder Stream hub's Apps row (frontends/nextjs's (workspace)/stream page — see AppsRow.tsx). Each links out to an external streaming/media service, either opened in a new tab or an embedded iframe, per embedMode. Managed via the hub's own Settings tile, not the god-panel.

bgColor.description: CSS color for the tile background, e.g. #000000

fgColor.description: CSS color for the tile's text

embedMode.description: "newtab" (default — safest, since most streaming services send X-Frame-Options/CSP headers that block iframe embedding by design) or "iframe" (opens in an in-page frame; only actually renders content for services that don't block framing)
